## Overview

**Laptop Price Analysis** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Khmer24 laptop fair-price model—Team 05, ITC AMS (July 2023).

## Background & Motivation

**Team 05 — Laptop Price Analysis** (ITC AMS, July 2023). Members: Ek Vong Panharith, Chou Vandy, Chorn Seyhak, Chea Rotha.

Laptop SKUs multiply each year; Cambodian buyers on Khmer24 need to know fair price for a given CPU/RAM/storage configuration.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

**From *Team05_project_guideline*:**

- **Objective:** Analyze laptop data, then develop an ML model predicting **laptop prices in the Cambodian market**
- **Data:** Scraped from **Khmer24**
- **Flow:** Train model on features→price relationship; use trained model for new listing predictions

## Data Collection & Preparation

Khmer24 laptop listings with CPU, RAM, storage, brand, condition, and price.

## Methodology & Analysis

EDA on spec–price correlations; feature matrix; regression or ensemble models; optional price recommendation for sample configs.

## Model Evaluation

Hold-out error on listings; brand premium analysis.

## Results & Key Learnings

Cambodia-specific laptop fair-price model and team report (July 2023).
